string-array.name: daily_quotes
string-array.item: Consistency is key
Small steps lead to big results
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most
The secret of your future is hidden in your daily routine
Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement
Your rhythm defines your life
Master your habits, master your destiny
Action is the foundational key to all success
You don\'t have to be extreme, just consistent
Success is the product of daily habits—not once-in-a-lifetime transformations
Focus on progress, not perfection
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become
Motivation gets you started. Habit keeps you going
Energy flows where attention goes
Excellence is not an act, but a habit
Fall in love with the process, and the results will follow
Do something today that your future self will thank you for
Willpower is like a muscle; the more you use it, the stronger it gets
Your habits will determine your future
Small disciplines repeated with consistency every day lead to great achievements
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can
Dream big. Start small. Act now
Success isn\'t always about greatness. It\'s about consistency
To change your life, you need to change your daily priorities
Keep going. Everything you need will come to you at the perfect time
Believe you can and you\'re halfway there
The expert in anything was once a beginner
Don\'t watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going
Quality is not an act, it is a habit
Turn your goals into daily habits
